tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page ground behind the report sheet: a neutral gray, like a desk under paper. Never put text directly on it.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: The report sheet: plain white paper in light, charcoal in dark. All ink tokens are checked against it.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Fact tiles, record cards and menus. Same as surface in light (cards are set apart by hairlines, not fills).

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: verbatim field lists, table heads, the map frame, directory street headers.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between records, table rows and card edges. Decorative only.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, checkboxes, secondary buttons) and plat boundary ticks. Meets 3:1 on surface.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Field labels, metadata, captions on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken. Holds 4.5:1 on all three.

tokens.name: civic
tokens.usage: The single accent, a deep navy: links, primary buttons, the focus ring, the current nav item. As text on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: civic-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state for civic links and buttons.

tokens.name: on-civic
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a civic fill (primary button).

tokens.name: civic-soft
tokens.usage: Tint for the current nav item, a targeted record and selected filter chips.

tokens.name: deep
tokens.usage: Charcoal for the rare solid fill (the cover, a printed header). Only on-deep text goes on it.

tokens.name: on-deep
tokens.usage: Text on deep.

tokens.name: on-deep-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on deep.

tokens.name: parcel
tokens.usage: The subject parcel and nothing else: its map fill, plat drawing, primary address chip. A muted survey ochre, never used for status or decoration.

tokens.name: parcel-edge
tokens.usage: Outline around the parcel fill so it holds its edge on any map or ground.

tokens.name: parcel-soft
tokens.usage: Tint for rows and nodes that refer to this exact parcel.

tokens.name: on-parcel
tokens.usage: Text on a parcel fill.

tokens.name: status-ok
tokens.usage: Issued, Active, Returned records. Always paired with the status word.

tokens.name: status-ok-soft
tokens.usage: Pill fill behind status-ok text.

tokens.name: status-closed
tokens.usage: Closed or completed: a finished state, not a problem.

tokens.name: status-closed-soft
tokens.usage: Pill fill behind status-closed text.

tokens.name: status-pending
tokens.usage: Draft, Scheduled, Submitted, Case Assigned: in progress.

tokens.name: status-pending-soft
tokens.usage: Pill fill behind status-pending text.

tokens.name: status-void
tokens.usage: Void, Inactive, Expired. Always carries its word.

tokens.name: status-void-soft
tokens.usage: Pill fill behind status-void text.

tokens.name: status-partial
tokens.usage: Partial response and incomplete source checks.

tokens.name: status-partial-soft
tokens.usage: Coverage-note fill and partial pill fill.

tokens.name: cat-permit
tokens.usage: Timeline category: permits, applications, certificates. Circle glyph.

tokens.name: cat-license
tokens.usage: Timeline category: liquor permits and business licenses. Square glyph.

tokens.name: cat-document
tokens.usage: Timeline category: City documents. Diamond glyph.

tokens.name: cat-enforcement
tokens.usage: Timeline category: complaints and housing-code cases. Triangle glyph.

tokens.name: cat-sale
tokens.usage: Timeline category: sales and ownership transfers. Ring glyph.

tokens.name: chart-land
tokens.usage: Land share in valuation bars and living-area subarea bars.

tokens.name: chart-improve
tokens.usage: Improvements share in valuation bars; non-living subareas.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring: 2px solid, 2px offset. Holds 3:1 on every surface in both themes.

styles.name: address
styles.usage: The property address in the masthead, uppercase as the City records it, Archivo at width 112. Fluid: clamp(2.6rem, 7vw, 4.5rem).

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Headline numbers in fact tiles. Tabular numerals.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows, fact-tile labels, table column heads. Uppercase, Archivo at width 90.

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: Two-story brick mixed-use building with retail and apartments.
styles.usage: The masthead summary line and section intros.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Dates and statuses come from the municipal record.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Field values, table cells, record metadata.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Captions, source notes, field labels (dt) in ink-muted.

styles.name: id
styles.usage: Permit, license, credential, case and parcel identifiers, MBLU, book/page. Never wraps mid-identifier.

styles.name: id-lg
styles.usage: Identifiers in the masthead ID tags.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap inside pills and between an icon and its word.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between label and value; chip rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Record card inner rhythm; field grid row gap.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones; minimum page gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between record groups.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Gap between report sections on phones.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Gap between report sections on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-tag
tokens.usage: Identifier tags, address chips and status labels.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, filter chips, record cards.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: The report sheet, map frames, photo and grouped panels.

tokens.name: radius-status
tokens.usage: Status labels. Square-cornered so they read as record stamps, not app badges.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: The report sheet's edge on the ground, with a 1px line border. Nothing else uses it.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Tooltips and menus only.

layout.note: Widths and breakpoints the report grid is built on.

tokens.name: sheet-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the report sheet.

tokens.name: rail-width
tokens.usage: Section rail width at 1180px and wider.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: Maximum line length for running text and descriptions.

tokens.name: bp-rail
tokens.usage: At and above: section rail on the left. Below: chip nav stuck to the top.

tokens.name: bp-phone
tokens.usage: Below: single column, 2-up fact tiles, tables become stacked rows.
